submittedParameters.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. One transparent RGBA game running sprite E09 COMPRESSION.
Image1 is edit target. Keep its correctly corrected SIDE VIEW boots exactly, planted boot at its existing horizontal ground height. KEEP BOOTS POINTING RIGHT, knees and ankles in the eastward sagittal plane, never turned out at viewer.
Make the running boy more crouched and compressed under his weight. The topmost ponytail pixel must be near y=155 of a 1254 canvas (12.4% from top), not y=95. Keep the same head size and LOWER the head and torso about 55 native pixels. Bend pelvis and knees MORE to lower upper body; redraw joint connections naturally. The hips also lower. Do not make longer shins, do not translate whole character or feet. This is LOW weight-bearing, not a taller stance. The distance from top hair to ground should be about1030 native pixels on1254 square.
Keep exactly two coherent legs. Far left shin supports weight at right, near right leg folds backward with its boot in SIDE VIEW. The planted boot retains a long horizontal side sole pointing right. Rear knee folded, no knee or toe facing viewer.
Images2/3 are 06 authoritative identity and east idle. Image4 is approved painting style. Image5 silver-haired girl is pose-only guide to compressed weight support and aligned boots; NEVER her identity, clothing, weapons or scale.
Keep original06 face, brown ponytail, gold ribbons/turquoise beads, ivory/gold/navy costume, white crossed shin bindings, black-gold boots, two hands. Anatomical RIGHT wand forward and LEFT rigid rectangular gold plaque behind. Arms retain same angles relative to torso. Short Q body.
Single full character, genuine alpha transparent native square>=1280. No floor, shadow, effects, text, grid or duplicate. Visual target GPT Image2.5 Sunburst/max; actual host selector unavailable.
